name: Sweet Potato Patties with Smoked Salmon & Creamy Greek Salad

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl, whisk the eggs.
Wash, peel, and coarsely grate the sweet potatoes. Use a paper towel or a clean cloth to squeeze out the excess moisture and add to the bowl with the eggs.
Peel and mince shallots. Add to the bowl along with flour, salt, and pepper; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 shallots
3 tbsp all-purpose flour
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Using a ¼ cup measure, form the potato mixture into patties. Working in batches if necessary, add patties to the skillet and flatten into ½-thick circles using the back of a spatula. Cook, flipping once, until golden and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch fresh dill
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
3 English cucumbers

instructions.primary_message: Using a knife, shave the dill leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Place in a large bowl.
Add yogurt, feta, vinegar, honey, and capers to the bowl with the dill; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese
3 tbsp apple cider vinegar
2 tbsp honey
1 ½ tbsp capers

instructions.primary_message: Halve olives and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise and add to the bowl.
Trim cucumbers; quarter lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide patties, salmon, and salad between plates. Enjoy!
